build_scalar_graph_ops: build a python module that creates scalar graphs and performs negate, add, and subtract operations using gtn
test_graph_composition: test composing two weighted finite-state transducer graphs using gtn.compose and verify the result with gtn.isomorphic
run_forward_score: run gtn.forward_score on a graph to compute the log-sum-exp score over all valid paths
test_viterbi_path: test finding the highest-scoring path through a graph using gtn.viterbi_path and verify with gtn.viterbi_score
build_graph_construction: build graphs using gtn.concat to concatenate, gtn.closure for Kleene star, and gtn.union for union of multiple graphs
